description: Build, run and analyze aerosol simulations; report concerns; develop, test and document Particula with illustrated examples.

defaultPrompt: Help me install Particula and check my local Python environment.
Build and run a small condensation simulation, then plot and explain the results.
Debug my Particula script and check its units, conservation, and time-step sensitivity.
interface.longDescription: Eight researcher workflows for setup, guidance, simulation design, execution, analysis, TOC figure design, debugging and issue reporting, plus six Particula repository skills for planning, development, testing, documentation, illustrated example authoring and review. Uses the selected checkout and environment. Reports require researcher review before posting. No hosted service, automatic Python installation or MCP server is included.

publication.release_notes: Literature studies lead with the strongest supported finding and revisit their TOC figure after revision. The TOC guidance adds a shared palette and examples for showing the study setting, identifying measured and modeled quantities, and labeling bars and particles at thumbnail size.

name: particula-helper
